Dribble 2026 — Xcode project for App Store upload
=================================================

This zip is the iOS app. Apple will not accept a build from this chat.
You upload it from a Mac with Xcode and a paid Apple Developer account ($99/year).

What's inside
-------------
Dribble-2026-iOS/
  ios/App/App.xcodeproj     ← open THIS in Xcode
  store/listing.txt         ← App Store description
  store/icons/icon-1024.png ← App Store icon
  native/www/client/privacy.html

On your Mac
-----------
1. Unzip this file.

2. Install Xcode from the Mac App Store, open it once, and install additional
   components if it asks.

3. Open:
     Dribble-2026-iOS/ios/App/App.xcodeproj

4. In Xcode, select the App target → Signing & Capabilities
   - Check "Automatically manage signing"
   - Team: your Apple Developer team
   - Bundle ID: com.dribble2026.app
     Change this to an ID you own (example: com.yourname.dribble2026)
     if that ID is already taken.

5. Product → Destination → Any iOS Device (arm64)
   Product → Archive

6. When the Organizer opens: Distribute App → App Store Connect → Upload.

7. In App Store Connect (https://appstoreconnect.apple.com):
   - New app: Dribble 2026
   - Category: Games / Sports
   - Age rating: 4+
   - Privacy policy URL: host privacy.html on any HTTPS site and paste the link
   - Paste store/listing.txt into the listing
   - Upload store/icons/icon-1024.png as the App Store icon
   - Export compliance: No (standard encryption only) — Info.plist already
     sets ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = false
   - Tracking: No
   - Data collected: none (saves stay on the player's phone)

You cannot skip the Mac. Linux and Windows cannot produce an App Store IPA.

Schools in the game are facsimile names (Lexington, Durham, Chapel Hill…) so
the listing does not use university or NCAA trademarks.
